notes: Dime benchmark pack v2. v1 axes kept (capability content assertions + efficiency budgets); v2 folds the /tmp/battery.py sweep canon into text-graded scenarios: best record, scoring leader, compare/h2h figures, overpaid/value boards (league + team scope), record-when-plays, clutch, Finals walkthrough carry, playoff pronoun carry. Tool-name pinning stays in pytest/battery; this pack grades what the user reads.
